description.zh: 冬狮郎经过资料室时，发现一扇窗没扣紧，吹进来的风把明天的巡查表翻得哗啦作响。他把散页按回日期排好，才发现每张纸角上都画着一小片形状不同的雪花。
description.en: Hitsugaya finds tomorrow’s patrol sheets blowing across the records room. He sorts them by date, then notices a different tiny snowflake drawn on every corner.

editorial.storyZh: 冬狮郎经过资料室时，发现一扇窗没扣紧，吹进来的风把明天的巡查表翻得哗啦作响。他把散页按回日期排好，才发现每张纸角上都画着一小片形状不同的雪花。原来值班的人担心页码被风吹乱，早就偷偷留了记号。他没有擦掉那些图案，只把最上面那张重新压平，在靠窗的地方放了一块镇纸。午后有人来领巡查表，他把纸递过去，特意给那人看了一眼最小的那片雪花。窗扣已修好，一叠文件在桌上安安静静地等着交接。冰沿手臂凝结成龙形，晶莹的冰翼在背后张开。
editorial.storyEn: Hitsugaya finds tomorrow’s patrol sheets blowing across the records room. He sorts them by date, then notices a different tiny snowflake drawn on every corner. Someone on duty had already devised a way to identify the pages. He leaves the drawings intact, flattens the top sheet and places a paperweight beside the unlatched window. At handover he points out the smallest snowflake. The repaired window keeps the remaining sheets in order. Ice gathers into a dragon around his arm and crystalline wings open behind him.
